aboutPage.headline: A senior CRO audit — without the <g>$2,000 invoice</g>.

aboutPage.p3: We're deliberately honest about what this is: the scores and projections are AI-generated estimates from the current market and your niche, not guarantees or predictions of the future. They're a fast, repeatable second opinion to point you at the highest-leverage changes — not a promise of results.
aboutPage.p1: Hiring a conversion consultant to tear down your store costs hundreds to thousands of dollars and takes weeks. Most ecommerce founders never do it — so they keep guessing about what's costing them sales.
aboutPage.bio: EliteVault is built by a small, founder-led team obsessed with ecommerce conversion. We use the product on real stores every week and ship improvements based on what actually moves scores.

freeAuditFaq.q0: What is an ecommerce web analyzer?
freeAuditFaq.a0: An ecommerce web analyzer reviews your store the way a buyer experiences it and reports what's hurting sales. EliteVault scores six categories, marks each issue on a screenshot, and ranks the fixes — free, in under a minute.
freeAuditFaq.q1: Is the website audit really free?
freeAuditFaq.a1: Yes. Your first audit is free — you get the overall score and an annotated screenshot with no credit card. Paid plans unlock the prioritized fixes, buyer-persona simulation and unlimited audits.
freeAuditFaq.a2: A website analyzer reviews a page the way a visitor experiences it and reports what helps or hurts results. EliteVault is a conversion-focused analyzer: it scores your store, marks the specific problems on a screenshot, and ranks the fixes by impact.
freeAuditFaq.q3: Can I audit a dropshipping store?
freeAuditFaq.a3: Yes. EliteVault works from your public URL, so it audits any dropshipping or Shopify store — no app install. You get a conversion score, an annotated screenshot and ranked fixes free.
freeAuditFaq.q4: What does the free audit check?
freeAuditFaq.a4: First impression and offer clarity, layout and hierarchy, trust and social proof, imagery and niche fit, CRO principles, and technical signals like speed — each scored and benchmarked against stores actually scaling.
freeAuditFaq.q5: Do I need to install anything?
freeAuditFaq.a5: No. Paste your URL and the analyzer captures and reviews your page automatically. Nothing to install, no code on your site.
freeAuditFaq.q6: Does it work for any website?
freeAuditFaq.a6: It's built for ecommerce and DTC stores (Shopify and beyond), where conversion is the goal. That focus is why the score and fixes are specific instead of generic.

personaFaq.q0: What is an AI buyer persona simulator?
personaFaq.a0: It's a tool that has an AI react to your store as a specific target customer — a defined persona with an age, location and interests. Instead of generic advice, you get how that buyer experiences your page: what convinces them and where they'd leave.
personaFaq.q1: How is this different from a buyer persona generator?
personaFaq.a1: A generator writes a persona profile. A simulator puts that persona to work: it reacts to your actual store URL in the persona's voice, so you see real friction on your real page — not a template document.
personaFaq.q2: Can I simulate more than one persona?
personaFaq.a2: Yes. Run different personas (e.g. young female US shopper vs. a 30s parent) against the same store and compare reactions. It's the fastest way to see whether your page matches the audience your ads target.
personaFaq.a3: You start free: create an account and run a free audit of your store (overall score + annotated screenshot). The full buyer-persona simulation is part of the Pro plan, alongside your prioritized fixes and unlimited audits.
personaFaq.q4: Is the persona reaction a prediction?
personaFaq.a4: No — it's a high-quality estimate of how a buyer in that segment is likely to react, not a guarantee of behavior. Use it to find obvious friction fast, then validate the fixes with your real traffic.

metaAdsFaq.q0: What is a Meta Ads simulator?
metaAdsFaq.a0: A Meta Ads simulator projects how a campaign will likely perform — spend, CPC, ROAS and revenue — before you run it, from your budget, AOV and niche benchmarks. EliteVault simulates three scenarios so you see the range before you commit.
metaAdsFaq.q1: What is a Meta Ads forecast?
metaAdsFaq.a1: A Meta Ads forecast projects how a campaign is likely to perform — spend, clicks, CPC, ROAS and revenue — before you run it, based on your budget, average order value and current niche benchmarks. It turns 'let's just test and see' into a planned range.
metaAdsFaq.a2: It's an honest estimate, not a prediction. The modeler uses real CPC/CPM/CTR/ROAS benchmarks and your store's numbers to project a realistic range — but actual results depend on your creative, offer and audience. Treat it as a planning tool, not a guarantee.
metaAdsFaq.q3: Why model three scenarios instead of one?
metaAdsFaq.a3: A single number hides risk. Conservative, balanced and aggressive cases show you the floor, the realistic middle and the upside together — so you fund a campaign knowing the downside, not just the dream.
metaAdsFaq.q4: Do I need to connect my ad account?
metaAdsFaq.a4: No. The forecast runs from a few inputs — budget, AOV and niche — so you can model a campaign before you've spent a dollar or even built it. Nothing to connect.
metaAdsFaq.a5: You can start free with a store audit — which now includes a modeled ROAS range for your store. Running the full 7-day Campaign Scenario Modeler is included on Pro (1 projection per month) and unlimited on Scale, alongside the Meta Ads optimizer targets and REST API.

winnersFaq.q0: How do you find winning Shopify stores?
winnersFaq.a0: We curate it: an AI assistant proposes candidate stores in each niche, and every one passes automated checks (site live, complete listing, niche fit) before it is published. Each entry shows modeled metrics so you can study what is likely working — they are estimates, not figures reported by the brands, and the library is re-checked periodically rather than in real time.
winnersFaq.a1: The Free plan includes 3 hand-picked winning stores with full metrics and the community feed. Pro and Scale unlock the full library, unlimited entries and image-similarity search.
winnersFaq.q2: How is this different from a Shopify spy tool?
winnersFaq.a2: Spy tools dump products and ad creatives. EliteVault is built for conversion: it pairs revenue-validated winners with image-similarity search (find the stores structurally closest to yours) and a free audit of your own store, so you copy the principles that actually convert.
winnersFaq.q3: Can I find winners in my specific niche?
winnersFaq.a3: Yes. Filter the library by niche so you study the stores most relevant to your category — what converts in skincare is different from supplements, and the library respects that.

The {n} {plural} in this list were chosen by an AI assistant and passed automated checks — not picked for looks{avg}.
nichePage.faqQ1: How do you verify these {plural} are actually winning?
nichePage.faqA1: We don't claim to audit their books. Candidate stores are proposed by an AI assistant and published only after automated checks (site live, complete listing, niche fit). Conversion rate, CTR and traffic are estimates modeled from public signals — not numbers reported by the brands — and we label them as such.
nichePage.faqQ2: Can I compare my store against these {plural}?
nichePage.faqA2: Yes — run a free EliteVault audit on your own URL. You get a conversion score, an annotated screenshot and ranked fixes, plus where you stand against your niche's average. No credit card, nothing to install.

faqContent.q0: How is this different from a heatmap or session-replay tool?
faqContent.a0: Hotjar and Clarity show what users do — EliteVault explains why. We don't need traffic to give you an audit. Our AI reads design fundamentals (color, hierarchy, copy, CRO heuristics) and benchmarks them against stores actually scaling on paid social today.
faqContent.q1: Where do the 'winning sites' in the Library come from?
faqContent.a1: An AI assistant proposes candidate stores in each niche, and every one is checked automatically (site live, complete listing, niche fit) before it enters the Library. The Library is re-checked periodically, and stores that go offline are removed. Ad-activity figures are labelled as estimates unless they come from a recent Meta Ad Library measurement.
faqContent.q2: Is the Analyzer accurate on small or new stores?
faqContent.a2: Yes — accuracy comes from design-fundamentals scoring, not traffic data. We grade what's visible on the page. A pre-launch store can get a meaningful audit before it ever runs an ad.
faqContent.a3: One click in the Stripe Customer Portal. No retention emails, no calls.
faqContent.q4: Do my analyses train your AI?
faqContent.a4: No. Your URLs, screenshots and audits are private to your account. We don't train models on customer data, and we don't share screenshots with third parties.
